description: A walkthrough tour, the way architects draw it: a `path` of points on the plan (mm, x east, y north) that the camera travels through along a smooth curve, at each point's camera `height` above its level's floor and `speed` (m/s) to the next point, pausing where `pause` is set. The camera looks along the path, or turns to a point's `lookAt` near it. Keep paths inside rooms and through door openings (not through walls): a point a metre outside the front door, one just inside, then the middle of each main room; pause 1–2 s where there is something to see. For an opening shot, start with an aerial point (height 15000+, speed 4–8). Alternatively `stops`: saved views or eye/target cameras with travel/hold seconds. `walk`: let visitors walk around from a spot on a floor. Check with list_tours and capture_view.

fov.description: Field of view for path tours, degrees (default 60)

height.description: Camera height above that floor, mm (default 1600 = eye height; 4000+ looks down, 15000+ is aerial)

level.description: Level id or name the point stands on (default the active level)

lookAt.description: Look at this while near/at this point instead of along the path (e.g. a fireplace, a view out of a window)

speed.description: m/s to the next point (default 1.2 walking; 0.6 slow, 2 brisk, 4 glide, 8 drone)

stops.description: Instead of a path: camera stops

travel.description: Seconds to get here from the previous stop, default 4

view.description: A saved view id or name, instead of position/target

walk.description: Let visitors walk around from here

toward.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

name: create_tour
title: Create walkthrough tour
